finding: Women with adverse neonatal outcomes had higher UA-PI and lower MCA-PI, MCA-PI/UA-PI ratio, gestational age (by ultrasound), AFV, BPP, estimated fetal weight, and neonatal birth weight compared to those with normal perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with adverse neonatal outcome had a higher rate of cesarean section mostly due to fetal distress and induced vaginal delivery due to oligohydramnios compared to the normal outcome group.
